item.title: Shinjuku Golden Gai — Guide
item.description: Golden Gai, a tiny district in Shinjuku’s Kabukicho, is one of Tokyo’s most atmospheric and characterful nightlife areas. Crammed into a warren of six narrow alleys are more than 200 minuscule bars, most seating only a handful of people, stacked in ramshackle two-storey buildings that have survived since the post-war era, giving the area a wonderfully retro, bohemian, almost ramshackle charm. Each tiny bar has its own distinct theme, character and owner-personality — from jazz and rock bars to film-themed, punk, literary or utterly eccentric establishments — and drinking here is an intimate, personal experience, chatting with the owner and a few other patrons in a space smaller than a living room.
